create_TrainFramework: create a TrainFramework instance for training optical flow models with AR augmentations
run_TrainFramework_epoch: run one training epoch with multi-stage config, timing meters, and distributed logging
validate_TrainFramework_model: validate a trained model on flow estimation using EPE metrics on noc and occluded regions
apply_ARFlow_transforms: apply ARFlow appearance and spatial transforms to augment training data with affine flow
add_fake_object_augmentation: add fake object occlusion augmentations to training images for robustness
